desc: The daily capsule, and the main character. Hero goes after the root causes rather than the symptom — the androgen activity, the stress load, and the micronutrients your hair is actually built from.
This is the part of the routine our founder found first, and the reason her hair loss slowed the first time.

The powder beside Hero, and the half most brands leave out because it is expensive and it does not fit in a capsule. {{partner}} carries the ingredients that have to be measured in grams: marine collagen for the scalp and the building blocks, and the inositols for the metabolic and hormonal side of this.
It is the part our founder added second — and the point at which the hair loss stopped rather than slowed.
contains: Myo-inositol and D-chiro-inositol, in the researched ratio
One scoop daily, in water or whatever you already drink
